dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete expert heuristics not in baseline models: required Secrets Manager JSON schema, proxy endpoint vs cluster endpoint distinction, MaxConnectionsPercent placement on target group, ACU‑based sizing table, mandatory SG ingress rule, IAM auth ↔ TLS coupling, and multi‑AZ subnet requirements. Only minor omission of newer engine‑specific limits.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides a concrete AWS‑specific procedure order (create proxy → create target‑group → attach target) with exact CLI flags, verification steps, and prerequisite checks. Lacks coverage of alternative IaC paths (Terraform/CFN) which would make the procedure fully comprehensive.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a detailed "NEVER" list (10 items) each with clear reasoning (e.g., why connecting to the cluster endpoint defeats the proxy, why MaxConnectionsPercent must not be 100%). Includes error‑handling guidance. Only minor omission is a warning about re‑using an existing proxy name.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete with description, triggers, keywords, version, author, license, compatibility, and verdict shape. The skill description clearly states WHAT it does, WHEN to invoke, and provides activation keywords. No missing elements.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Information is layered: quick navigation, high‑level mindset, deep heuristics, step‑by‑step commands, NEVER list, output format, and error handling. Slight overload in the long heuristics section prevents a perfect score.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions (proxy creation) are tightly constrained by prerequisite verification and explicit checklist. Creative aspects (e.g., choosing tags) are left open. Could tighten region handling and name‑collision checks, but overall well calibrated.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable CloudOps skill pattern: Mindset, Dependency Graph, Heuristics, Stepwise Procedure, NEVER list, Output Contract, Worked Example, Error Handling. Structure is coherent and aids comprehension.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides complete CLI commands, checklist, verification commands, and worked examples that the model output reproduces correctly. Minor gap: no explicit guidance for handling pre‑existing resources (proxy name conflict) or idempotent runs.
